verses.text: I looked up again, and I saw a scroll flying through the air.
The angel asked me, "What do you see?" I answered, "I see a flying scroll, twenty cubits long and ten cubits wide."

Then he said to me, "This is the curse that is going out over the whole land. As one side of the scroll says, everyone who steals will be thrown out. As the other side says, everyone who swears falsely will be thrown out.

I will send it out," says the LORD of Armies, "and it will enter the house of the thief and the house of anyone who swears falsely by my name. It will stay inside that house and destroy it completely, both its wood and its stones."
Then the angel who was talking with me came forward and said to me, "Look up and see what is appearing."
I asked, "What is it?" He answered, "It is a basket for measuring grain." Then he added, "This is what the sin of the people looks like throughout the land."
Then the lead cover, weighing a talent, was lifted, and there was a woman sitting inside the basket.
He said, "This is Wickedness." He pushed her back into the basket and shoved the heavy lead cover down over its opening.
Then I looked up, and I saw two women flying toward us with the wind in their wings. They had wings like a stork's, and they lifted the basket up between the earth and the sky.
I asked the angel who was talking with me, "Where are they taking the basket?"
He answered, "To the land of Babylonia, to build a house for it. When the house is ready, the basket will be set there in its own place."
